issue.body:
### Bug

Fix `migration-generate` test suite which exits before executing all the tests due to `process.exit(0)` call in `MigrationGenerateCommand#handler`:

https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/blob/befe4f9cbf17139bfaba83ae8a00e56b071df334/src/commands/MigrationGenerateCommand.ts#L204

### Description of change

* Remove `process.exit(0)` call from `MigrationGenerateCommand#handler`, to make all tests execute until success/failure.
* Fix `resultsTemplates` for each database driver so that tests succeed.

### Progress

- [x] postgres
- [ ] mssql _(tests hang when creating the pool, and time out after 90 seconds)_
- [x] mysql
- [x] mariadb
- [x] sqlite
- [x] better-sqlite3
- [x] oracle
- [x] cockroachdb

Fixes: #10360

issue.body:
### Issue description

npm test exit early

### Expected Behavior

`npm test` should run all the tests and all the tests should pass.

### Actual Behavior

`npm test` existed earlier after commands - generate.

The bug was probably introduced by this PR: https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/9288


### Steps to reproduce

If you check all the circle CI logs, all tests exit early.

If you disabled the `commands - generate` test, all other test cases will be executed and fail at `database schema > enums`

### My Environment

| ---                 | ---      |
| Operating System    |      MacOS    |
| Node.js version     | 20.8.0  |
| Typescript version  | 5.2.2  |
| TypeORM version     | 0.3.17  |
